tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List public agent definitions and exact revisions in this execution Node's catalog. Catalog edits affect new conversations only until explicitly applied; they never rewrite this turn's roster or existing children. No provider configuration or credentials are returned.

tools.name: add_agent
tools.description: Add an agent definition to this execution Node's catalog. Use a unique lowercase key, display name and instructions. Optional model identifies an existing provider/model, never credentials. This does not change this conversation's roster; use apply_agents only when explicitly requested.

tools.name: edit_agent
tools.description: Edit one catalog agent using its exact ID and decimal-string revision from list_agents. Omitted fields are preserved; explicit null clears optional fields. Inspect conflicts instead of silently rebasing. Existing conversations, queued turns and children keep their captures until explicit application for future admission.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description: Remove exactly one agent definition from this execution Node's catalog using its ID and decimal-string revision from list_agents. Confirm the user's intent before deletion. Existing conversations, queued turns and children retain their immutable definitions and history; this does not delete any conversation or automatically change its roster.

tools.name: apply_agents
tools.description: Explicitly replace this conversation's selected agent roster for future turn admission only. Supply the complete desired list of catalog IDs with exact decimal-string revisions, and this conversation's exact expected_session_revision from initialization or a completed apply_agents receipt. An empty list clears future role selection. Never silently rebase conflicts. This running turn, already queued turns and existing children keep their immutable captures; this cannot target another conversation.

tools.name: spawn_agent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a child agent when the user's instructions allow it. Delegate independent research, implementation or review that benefits from separate context or parallel work; do trivial lookups and tightly coupled steps yourself, and do not redo a child's work. The child does not see this conversation: write a self-contained task with the goal, relevant paths, constraints, whether edits are allowed, and expected output with path:line evidence. Give a short display title separate from the task. By default this waits for the child's final result; use it for results this turn needs and verify them before relying on them. Set background to true only when the user asks or long-running work is not needed this turn; it returns the child session ID while the child runs. Do not poll background work: its durable completion arrives as a background notice, and this conversation continues when idle if automatic continuation is enabled. Until then, tell the user it is running; never claim its results were integrated. Use guide_agent for new directions. A new child inherits this turn's project, work mode and permission. Choose a role listed in this tool when it fits; use its exact listed key and never invent a role. If no role fits or the roster is empty, omit role or use null to inherit this conversation's model and instructions. worktree selects a registered worktree in this project. If concurrent children could edit the same files, create one with create_worktree and pass its ID; otherwise give children sharing a directory disjoint files. Independent calls may run concurrently. To reuse an idle child owned by this conversation, copy its exact returned session ID and normally omit role; never reconstruct the ID. It keeps its history, role, model, worktree and settings. Busy or foreign children cannot be reused. Children cannot delegate further.

tools.name: guide_agent
tools.description: Give new directions to a running child owned by this conversation. Copy its exact returned session ID; never reconstruct it. Admission is durable; the child receives them only after its entire current tool batch settles, preserving its history, role, model, worktree and permissions. This does not interrupt an in-flight model response or tool. This returns a queued guidance receipt, not the child's final result. If the child has finished and the user requests follow-up work, use spawn_agent with that session ID and a new task instead.

tools.name: wait_agent
tools.description: Wait for a child owned by this conversation and collect its durable final status and answer. Use it when the user requests waiting or result collection, or to collect the complete answer from a background notice. Do not poll running background work; its completion arrives as a notice. Guiding background work alone does not request waiting. Copy its exact returned session ID; never reconstruct it. Main-session guidance returns early with guidance_pending so this conversation can apply the user's direction; resume waiting only if the user still requests it. This does not create or replay work.
